candidate_mount_contract: Only candidate.py and public fixtures.json are mounted; oracle.json is not mounted or passed to the candidate container.
auditor_mount_contract: Auditor source, fixture, and hidden oracle are read-only; candidate raw is a separate read-only mount; only audit output is writable.
launch_correction: Writable output bind mount omits the unsupported bare rw flag; this allocation has distinct output paths/container names and is not a retry of allocation 01.
stop_rule: One candidate call; auditor once only on candidate exit 0. Any error preserves first outcome and terminates allocation.
